name: IRGB
description: Image Reasoning Generation Benchmark (IRGB) objectively evaluates how well image generation models handle reasoning-intensive prompts. Unlike standard aesthetic benchmarks, IRGB focuses on whether models can correctly reason during generation about spatial relationships, counting, text rendering, physical properties, occlusion, and compositional accuracy. Each prompt is run 3 times per model to account for stochastic variation; each generated image is judged strictly pass/fail by a human evaluator with no partial credit. When supported, image-editing prompts are tested similarly.
evaluation_method: human pass/fail judgement, 3 samples per prompt per model
general_score_metric: pass rate (strict pass/fail across 3 generations per prompt)
typical_sota_score: varies by model; even frontier image models fail many reasoning-intensive prompts
reputation: A small but well-targeted reasoning-in-generation benchmark referenced by Epoch AI as a multimodal classic-format benchmark with significant headroom; companion track to IUMB.
notes: 20 prompts (16 image-generation, 4 image-editing). Models evaluated include Nano Banana Pro/2, GPT-Image-1.5/2, Grok Imagine, FLUX 2 Max, Seedream, Qwen Image 2 Pro, Hunyuan Image 3, Recraft v4, Midjourney v8, Kling Image, and others. Maintained as a live leaderboard; companion to the IUMB undergraduate-math benchmark.
